The mechanism is a square-sum load/issue-order difference: three lfs element loads of one vector and three fmuls/fmadds products, where the target issues the third load before the first product. (2) A SOURCE FIX, src/game/world/camera.c, found while reading the relocation SYMBOLS of the same function and unrelated to the rule: at +0x1b0/+0x1c0 our stream read lbl_80345FD0 and lbl_80345FD8 in the order the target reads lbl_80345FD8 and lbl_80345FD0 -- the two pool doubles were SWAPPED. Bytes were identical on both words (c8400000/c8800000), so every score-based check reported them as matching. Cure, one commutative-chain reordering: `(f32)-(difference * lbl_80345FD0 * lbl_80345FD8 - lbl_80345FC8)` -> `(f32)-(difference * lbl_80345FD8 * lbl_80345FD0 - lbl_80345FC8)`. Landed FIRST (commit 3588e5ec0) so the rule was derived against a correct body; probe.py scored it NEUTRAL at real 12, exactly as the score-invisibility law predicts, and the relocation dump is the actual proof.
